title: Compensation – sending by e‑mail in Czechia

en.title: Compensation – send by email in Czechia
en.summary: Businesses can share compensations by email directly from Business Central.
en.details: We added the **Send** and **Email** actions to the **Compensation Card** and **Posted Compensation Card** pages. We also added a **Report Selection – Compensation** page to configure default reports to use when you print, email, and do other output operations for compensation documents.
